annotations.title: One Taskmarket task, briefed: checklist + submit command

description: Use before starting one task: reward, hours left, entries vs market median, flags, deliverable type, checklist lines from the brief, an excerpt, its rank among picks and the exact submit command. id = task id or TSK- code; no id = the current top pick. PAID: $0.005 per call, no API key or account, or free with a Juno Work Pass. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/taskmarket/brief.

id.description: Taskmarket task id (0x + 64 hex) or reference code (TSK-…); omit for the current top pick

pass.description: Optional Juno Work Pass token (jp1....). With a valid pass this call is not charged. Prefer setting it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
